stories.canonicalTitle: BIS Issues Interim Final Rule Lowering Performance-Density Threshold for Export Controls on Mid-Tier AI Accelerators
stories.whySelected: The rule immediately broadens US export controls to accelerator designs previously engineered below the old threshold, changing compliance and product-planning assumptions.

stories.canonicalTitle: Fenwick Quantum Group Demonstrates Distance-9 Surface Code Logical Qubit Below Threshold for One Million Cycles
stories.whySelected: The experiment materially advances the demonstrated boundary of fault-tolerant quantum computing and is supported by a primary preprint plus independent coverage.

stories.canonicalTitle: Quarrystone Patches Critical Flaw CVE-2026-41882 Exposing Write-Ahead Logs to Unauthenticated Clients
stories.whySelected: Operators of affected Quarrystone versions need to assess exposure and patch promptly because the flaw can expose complete write-ahead logs without authentication under a common configuration.

stories.canonicalTitle: FSB Mandates Daily Reserve Attestation and 80% Overnight Assets for Large Payment Stablecoins
stories.whySelected: The final rule imposes a concrete reserve-composition and disclosure regime on large payment stablecoins, with direct balance-sheet and compliance consequences.

stories.canonicalTitle: Northbridge Cloud us-east-2 Control Plane Disruption Freezes Scaling for Over Six Hours
stories.whySelected: The prolonged control-plane failure blocked launches and scaling while leaving workloads running, exposing a consequential resilience gap for customers relying on automated capacity changes.

stories.canonicalTitle: Aperture Releases Nimbus-7 72B MoE Model Under Restrictive Non-Serving Licence
stories.whySelected: The weight release expands deployable model options, but its licence sharply limits third-party serving and requires careful compliance review before external deployment.

stories.canonicalTitle: Meridian Reportedly Tests 2M-Token Context Model with Enterprise Customers
stories.whySelected: Independent sourced reporting raises the credibility of a model that could change long-document workflows and retrieval economics, while the lack of official confirmation warrants caution.

stories.canonicalTitle: Sable ORM 6.2.0 Bug Silently Drops Rows in Batched Upserts Exceeding Connection Pool
stories.whySelected: Silent data loss creates direct operational risk for users of the affected release; the upstream reproduction and independent coverage make the issue actionable despite its unresolved status.

stories.canonicalTitle: Anvil Defers Two Data-Centre Campuses as Grid Interconnection Slips to 2029
stories.whySelected: The project deferrals are concrete evidence that electricity interconnection queues are delaying new compute capacity rather than merely raising its cost.

stories.canonicalTitle: Rust 1.94 Enables Parallel Compiler Front End by Default and Stabilises Const APIs
stories.whySelected: A default compiler-path change can affect build performance and compatibility across the Rust ecosystem, and the release is confirmed by official sources.

stories.canonicalTitle: Linux 6.19 Merge Window Adopts Deadline-Aware Fair Scheduler Rework
stories.whySelected: The scheduler rework changes a core kernel mechanism for latency-sensitive tasks and merits early testing by operators with real-time-adjacent workloads.

stories.canonicalTitle: Vantiq Systems Cuts Full-Year Revenue Guidance by 9% as Enterprise Renewals Slip
stories.whySelected: The filing-backed outlook cut and concentration in delayed multi-year renewals provide a meaningful signal about enterprise purchasing cycles and Vantiq's execution risk.

stories.canonicalTitle: Measurement Study Identifies Rack-Level Power Capping as Cause of 11% AI Accelerator Idle Time
stories.whySelected: The production-cluster measurements identify electrical power limits, rather than scheduling alone, as a material source of lost accelerator utilisation.

stories.canonicalTitle: US Initial Jobless Claims Hold Steady at 214,000
stories.whySelected: Retained for macro continuity, but the reading remains within the recent range and does not indicate an inflection.

emergingSignals.label: 算力瓶頸移出晶片本身
emergingSignals.rationale: 今日三個不相關主體揭示算力供給與利用率同時受晶片之外的約束：BIS 擴大加速器出口限制，生產叢集因機櫃功率上限損失運算時間，Anvil 又因電網併網延誤而推遲園區。三者分屬政策、營運與基礎建設層，卻共同壓縮可實際部署的算力。若只是巧合，後續專案時程與叢集利用率應不再反覆受監管和供電條件拖累。

curatorNotes: All 79 items have recorded decisions. Thirteen A/B stories give the Editor adequate choice; routine crypto moves were excluded, and steady jobless claims are retained only as Tier C continuity. Treat the Meridian report as unconfirmed despite improved sourcing.
